summary: An American ranch windpump: an 8 m four-legged galvanised steel lattice tower with girts and X-braced panels… joints pump_rod, head, wheel; options vane_colour; sockets socket_spout, socket_tank, socket_platform.
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.windmill_water_pump or place "prefab": "windmill_water_pump" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d().
